findings.title: Caller-controlled expected hashes make the new source and GO authority self-signed
findings.explanation: static_gate obtains M1091_EXPECTED_RELEASE_OUTER_SHA256, M1091_EXPECTED_RUNNER_SHA256 and M1091_EXPECTED_M1092_OUTER_SHA256 from the caller environment. There is no independently frozen caller or hard trust root for those values. An attacker can mutate the contract/source set, recompute contract and release seals, update the release runner hash, and pass the new hashes in the environment. Separately, an attacker can create a forged M1092 review with the required GO status/boolean, recompute its manifest/outer seal, and pass that outer hash. Both constructions satisfy the current runner checks.
findings.impact: The runner cannot distinguish independent M1092 authorization from a caller-authored GO. M1091 may not consume its attempt or start DC/VCS.

findings.title: Tool, library and cell-model identities are path-fixed but not hash-pinned or symlink-rejected
findings.explanation: The runner uses absolute versioned paths for dc_shell, VCS, slow/fast DB and the Verilog cell model, but static_gate neither hashes these files nor rejects symlinks. Contract sources do have exact hashes and direct-symlink rejection; the external tool/library boundary does not.
findings.impact: Even after repairing the GO trust root, a path replacement could change the diagnostic flow identity.

minimum_repair.trusted_authority_requirement: Introduce an independently sealed caller/launch authority whose exact identity cannot be selected by the same environment being validated. The successor must reject re-signed contract/release/runner and forged-GO artifacts even when all caller-visible hashes are recomputed.
minimum_repair.tool_identity_requirement: Pin and verify the exact dc_shell, VCS, slow DB, fast DB and cell-model identities, and reject direct or resolved symlinks, before attempt consumption.
required_regressions: re-signed contract/release/runner attack rejects after every caller-visible hash is updated
forged GO review attack rejects after review manifest and outer seal are recomputed
wrong caller path and caller hash reject
all 22 observation outputs remain fanout-only with no functional feedback
all 22 first-X checks, header/raw timeouts, 128-cycle bound and stage prints remain exact
existing result, attempt, work and preheld-lock attacks reject
exactly one fresh DC and one mapped short case remain the only future EDA actions
no SAIF, toggle dumping or random initialization is introduced
any output remains diagnostic-only and cannot be cited as PPA
